title: Single violation: market order submitted while market is closed
notes: as_of is 2026-08-27T22:00:00Z; market.clock.is_open is false (next_open 2026-08-28T13:30:00Z). The literal order is a plain (non-extended-hours) market order, which is not valid while the market is closed -- R6 fires, BLOCKING. There is no auto-repair for a session mismatch (converting the trader's order type or deferring it to the next session without confirmation is not something OrderGuard does silently), so the basket BLOCKs; the trader would need to resubmit once the market opens (or explicitly request extended-hours eligibility, which this instruction didn't). Zero orders reach the broker.
